scopes.authorization_rationale: The pilot contract carries an explicit destination authorization outcome and permission-denied state; executable runtime must prove authorization-negative behavior before acceptance.
scopes.tenant_isolation_rationale: The pilot projects tenant/environment references across context transitions; executable runtime must prove cross-tenant isolation and reference clearing before acceptance.

scopes.authorization_rationale: CAP-INV-002 requires server-side search execution permission checks; the boundary must prove permission-denied behavior before runtime acceptance.
scopes.tenant_isolation_rationale: CAP-INV-002 Search is single-selected-Tenant with no silent fallback; the boundary must prove missing, wildcard and cross-tenant scopes fail closed.

scopes.authorization_rationale: INV-EVS-001 can render protected search/event state but server authorization remains authoritative; frontend runtime must prove permission-denied rendering never exposes protected content before acceptance.
scopes.tenant_isolation_rationale: Event Search deep-link and visible context carry tenant/environment scope; frontend runtime must prove malformed or cross-tenant client state cannot silently widen the selected tenant context.

scopes.authorization_rationale: CAP-INV-004 exposes permission-gated Telemetry Event projections with distinct raw/rendered outcomes; executable runtime must prove denied access returns no protected projection and raw-denied paths leak no raw or raw-derived sensitive content.
scopes.tenant_isolation_rationale: CAP-INV-004 inspection and pivot context preserve tenant/environment/event identity; executable runtime must prove missing, wildcard and cross-tenant source or pivot context fails closed with no reference widening.

scopes.authorization_rationale: CAP-INV-005 projects caller-owned Hunt workspace context containing references to Query, Search Job, Hypothesis, Case and Incident objects. The bounded runtime must prove denied caller-provided access decisions fail closed and never expose denied reference identity or projected content.
scopes.tenant_isolation_rationale: CAP-INV-005 workspace state is single-tenant/environment and every referenced object is tenant-scoped. The runtime must prove missing, wildcard and cross-tenant workspace/reference context fails closed with no reference widening.

scopes.authorization_rationale: CAP-INV-006 projects caller-owned Saved Search / Query Asset state containing a stable Shared Query/version reference, parameters, source/field prerequisites, author/validation metadata and lineage/deprecation metadata. The bounded runtime must prove denied caller-provided access decisions fail closed and never expose denied Query identity or projected asset content.
scopes.tenant_isolation_rationale: CAP-INV-006 assets and their Query/source context are tenant-scoped and cross-tenant copy is explicitly excluded. The runtime must prove missing, wildcard, asset/query tenant mismatch and cross-tenant handoff context fail closed with no scope widening.
